extracted.name: Caprese Salad
extracted.description: A summer staple! The thing that sets this Caprese Salad apart from the usual is that it's tossed with a garlic-herb vinaigrette first then finished with a balsamic glaze. Keeps it looking "clean" with terrific flavour! Serve as a side, on toast with avocado or as a light meal with bread.
ingredient_lines: 220 g/7oz bocconcini / baby or cherry mozzarella (, halved (Note 1))
500 g / 1 lb cherry or grape tomatoes (, halved)
1/2 cup basil leaves (, torn or roughly chopped)
1/2 tsp Dijon mustard ((or other non spicy mustard))
1/4 tsp each dried oregano (, parsley, thyme (or rosemary))
instruction_lines: Place Dressing ingredients in a jar and shake very well. Adjust to taste.
Place tomatoes, bocconcini and most of the basil in a bowl. Drizzle over dressing, toss gently.
Transfer to shallow serving bowl. Just before serving, drizzle with balsamic glaze and sprinkle with remaining basil.
